Katie O'Sullivan was forced to drop out of her junior 2,000 metres with leg trouble but will still go so long as her leg holds up. Belgrave members were in action in several of the events held at Ilford on the weekend before Christmas and the most successful was young Katie O'Sullivan who won the under 13 Girls 2.5Km race with five seconds to spare in 15:30.
